 /**
  * Extracts `android:versionCode` from [mainManifest] into [versionCodeFile] as the fallback base

  *
- * `variant.sources.manifests.all` combines the static main manifest with any manifests generated
- * by other tasks in one `Provider`. Reading that list in a plain `Provider` transform fails
- * task-graph resolution whenever another task generates a manifest. Wiring [mainManifest] as a task
- * input lets Gradle resolve those tasks first.
+ * Runs as a task rather than a `Provider` transform because [mainManifest] is selected from
+ * `variant.sources.manifests.all`, which can include manifests generated by other tasks. Gradle
+ * refuses to read that list in a provider before those tasks run, but reads a task input only when
+ * the task runs. Wiring [mainManifest] as a task input instead makes Gradle run any
+ * manifest-generating tasks first, even though the main manifest is a static source file.
  */
